title: High Bandwidth Memory: What It Is and Why It Matters
summary_en: High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) is a critical enabling technology for artificial intelligence. The authors of this paper synthesize analysis of the HBM ecosystem for researchers and policymakers.
title_cn: High Bandwidth Memory: What It Is and Why It Matters

title: Do Robots Lure Us to War? The Impact of the Robotic Revolution on the Propensity for Armed Conflict
summary_en: The author developed a framework to understand the decision space for the use of force in the presence of emerging technology and applied it to autonomous weapons systems.
title_cn: Do Robots Lure Us to War? The Impact of the Robotic Revolution on the Propensity for Armed Conflict

title: Private Industry Approaches to Network and Security Operations Centers: Best Practices for the Department of the Air Force
summary_en: The authors describe how private companies structure, organize, and staff network and security operations centers, highlighting practices that could be applied to the Department of the Air Force’s efforts to modernize command and control.
title_cn: Private Industry Approaches to Network and Security Operations Centers: Best Practices for the Department of the Air Force

title: The Strategist's Dilemma: Agent-Neutral and Agent-Relative Reasons in U.S. AI Strategy
summary_en: Advanced artificial intelligence (AI) creates a strategist’s dilemma: U.S. leaders owe duties to their citizens and face obligations to prevent catastrophic harm to anyone. The author argues that both kinds of reasons should shape U.S. AI strategy.
title_cn: The Strategist's Dilemma: Agent-Neutral and Agent-Relative Reasons in U.S. AI Strategy

title: The Transatlantic Artificial Intelligence Calculus: U.S.–European Union and Member State AI Cooperation in an Era of Strategic Competition
summary_en: This report provides a strategic framework for assessing the conditional value of artificial intelligence partnerships across different technological futures and presents options for transatlantic cooperation that advance U.S. strategic interests.
title_cn: The Transatlantic Artificial Intelligence Calculus: U.S.–European Union and Member State AI Cooperation in an Era of Strategic Competition

title: Winning the AI Pentathlon Requires Endurance: The Case for Resilience and Risk Management as Core Elements of Competitive National AI Strategy
summary_en: Global artificial intelligence (AI) competition is not just a sprint to develop advanced AI but also a marathon to accumulate its net benefits. Resilience is a strategic advantage as AI integration likely will involve persistent disruption.
title_cn: Winning the AI Pentathlon Requires Endurance: The Case for Resilience and Risk Management as Core Elements of Competitive National AI Strategy
